attempts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production sprite sheet for an existing illustrated desktop dog, twelve consecutive frames of ONE tail-chasing loop.
Reference image 1 (idle/00.png): canonical character identity, anatomy, adult proportions, warm red/cream fur, rendering and outline style. Reference image 2 (old chase-tail contact sheet): historical animation to IMPROVE, not poses to duplicate.
Primary request: redraw Kaifik the red Shiba Inu naturally chasing his own curled tail, taking quick small steps around a tight circle. Make a coherent, believable whole-body clockwise turn, with fixed camera, consistent body volume, smoothly rotating hips and shoulders and paws actually stepping to drive the turn. Head/neck bends back toward the dog's own tail, playful concentrated expression. The spine forms a gentle natural curve, not a rubber ring. No biting/detaching the tail.
Layout: EXACTLY TWELVE complete separate dogs arranged in a clean regular FOUR-COLUMN by THREE-ROW sprite grid. Reading order left-to-right, top-to-bottom is chronological. Each invisible cell the same size, same floor level relative to its cell, consistent anatomical scale. Large transparent empty gutters between all dogs and generous outer padding; every paw, ear and tail fully contained in its cell. NO grid lines or text. Genuine transparent background, opaque fur.
Turn progression across frames, describing the CHEST/PELVIS direction, independently of the head looking back: 00 front three-quarter turned slightly right; 01 right-front three-quarter; 02 almost right profile; 03 right profile continuing into rear-right; 04 rear-right three-quarter; 05 almost rear; 06 rear turned slightly left; 07 rear-left three-quarter; 08 almost left profile; 09 left profile continuing into front-left; 10 front-left three-quarter; 11 almost frontal, one small turn before 00. Approximately equal 30 degree increments around a full turn. Do NOT repeat the first image at the end.
Natural gait: weight stays over supporting paws, inside paws take shorter steps, outside paws advance around circle. Alternating support with modest paw lifts, no rigid spinning of a planted dog. Maintain exactly four anatomically attached legs with clean occlusion; hidden legs may naturally be obscured. No extra legs, duplicated paws, broken joints, hopping on two legs or crossed tangled legs. Curled tail stays attached to rump and follows pelvis. No abrupt shrinking/growing, changing leg lengths or changing breed. Small consistent body bob only. Keep warm outlined detailed cartoon fur matching canonical reference, not photorealism, chibi, 3D or vector flat art.
Do not draw anything else: no ground shadows, motion trails, arrows, symbols, props, cursor, window, collars, humans, text or labels. This is one temporally coherent set, not twelve unrelated illustrations.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create an animation sprite sheet, not a collection of poses.
Reference 1 is the canonical Kaifik character standing. Reference 2 shows his adult long-legged proportions in side view. These are identity/style references ONLY. Draw a NEW anatomically coherent tail-chasing animation. Preserve their red Shiba coat, cream muzzle/chest/belly/paws, almond eyes, dark warm fine outline, softly detailed fur, curled tail and adult body proportions. Not a puppy, not squat.
Exactly EIGHT consecutive frames of Kaifik chasing his own tail in a small clockwise circle. The dog moves around a compact circle by taking short alternating paw steps, with the whole torso rotating smoothly. Head looks back to his own attached tail, shoulders and spine gently curved, consistent body volume. Express happy playful concentration. Keep chest and rump orientation progressing in ONE direction. Fixed camera, no camera rotations. No changing dog size between frames.
LAYOUT: TWO ROWS of FOUR equal invisible cells. Read frame 1-4 across top row then 5-8 across bottom row. Genuine transparent background and generously separated full dogs in every cell, ample outer margins. One complete dog per cell, all ears/tail/paws visible. Same anatomical scale and floor baseline within every cell. No labels, numbers, arrows, lines, shadows or anything except the dogs.
Strict orientation storyboard, describing BODY/PELVIS direction (head turns backwards towards tail):
1. FRONT: chest faces viewer, bent head looks over dog's right flank (image LEFT), body starting clockwise turn.
2. FRONT-RIGHT THREE QUARTER: chest and pelvis face diagonally toward screen right and viewer. Inside front paw lifts to step right.
3. RIGHT PROFILE: torso points screen RIGHT, rump on image left. Head looks back LEFT towards curled tail. Short curved spine, paws making a turning step.
4. REAR-RIGHT THREE QUARTER: rump becomes closer to viewer, chest points diagonally away to screen right. Head looks back toward its rump, NOT a left-facing front view.
5. REAR: rump squarely faces viewer, back of torso/head visible; head peeks around right flank. Correct rear anatomy. One hind paw lifts slightly.
6. REAR-LEFT THREE QUARTER: rump still closer to viewer, chest points diagonally away to screen LEFT. Head looks back toward its tail.
7. LEFT PROFILE: torso points screen LEFT, rump on image right, head looks back RIGHT toward tail. This must be the opposite side to frame 3.
8. FRONT-LEFT THREE QUARTER: chest approaches frontal again from LEFT side, next small step naturally returns to frame 1. No duplicated endpoint.
CRITICAL: frame3 and frame7 MUST face opposite directions. Frames4-6 show the BACK. Frames1,2,8 show the CHEST. Do not replace these required viewpoints with random head looks or repeat similar front poses.
Paws drive the circle: low modest alternating steps with weight on support paws, short inside steps and longer outside steps, all joints attached correctly. Exactly four legs, allow natural occlusion, no extra feet/legs, no tangled crossing, no long sideways kicks, no hopping. Curled tail attached to hips in every frame. Body not inflated or shortened in rear views. Smooth modest bob and steady proportions across all eight frames.
Background fully transparent with clean alpha; all fur opaque. No scenery, ground plane, cast shadows, effects, colored outlines, colored fringe, checkerboard, words or props.

Use case: background-extraction.
Edit target: the attached eight-dog animation sheet. Preserve EXACTLY all eight dogs, their poses, fur colors, shape, scale, ordering and all four legs per dog. Do not redraw, rearrange or crop them.
Remove the entire brown gradient background and every cast shadow. Return all EIGHT separate full-body dogs as clean opaque cutouts on a genuinely transparent background, in the same two rows of four. Transparent pixels everywhere outside the dog silhouettes and between their legs. Dog fur must be fully opaque, including white paws, cream chest and red coat. Preserve fine dark fur edge contours with clean antialiasing; no brown halo, no colored fringe, no translucent bodies. No shadows or checkerboard. Do NOT add any background or new content. The output is the same sprite sheet with only the background removed and the dogs made fully opaque.
